messages: Morgan (PM): sharing a quick mock for eval-run filters + tagging and the empty state copy. wanted feedback on hierarchy and keyboard flows. link: https://figma.com/... :eyes.; Eli (UX): looks good. main ask — can we make the tag filter chip row sticky so filters don't scroll away when you review diffs? feels important for long runs.; Adan (FE): sticky is doable but needs a height calc for small screens. could collapse into a 'Filters' button on <640px.; Sarah (A11y): two a11y nits: 1) chips need role="button" + aria-pressed. 2) empty state CTA should be a real button element and keyboard focusable.; Jules (Design): empty state copy options: "No runs match these filters" vs "No results yet — try removing filters or creating a new prompt set." prefer the latter because it's action-oriented.; Morgan (PM): action-oriented seems right. shorter variant for compact: "No results — try removing filters." add secondary CTA to create a prompt set.; Eli (UX): ordering suggestion: filters row, then search, then sort dropdown. search should autofocus on open via keyboard shortcut "+".; Adan (FE): quick note about perf — when multiple tag chips are selected we should debounce filter updates (200ms) to avoid re-render thrash on large evals.; Sarah (A11y): keyboard flow: tab order must hit filters, then search, then results. chips should be reachable with arrow keys once focus is inside the chip group. add aria-label like "Filter tags".; Jules (Design): visual contrast: selected chip uses brand blue 600 on white — contrast < 4.5:1 for small text. propose adding a 1px focus ring and using blue 700.; Eli (UX): also want a quick multi-select pattern: hold Shift to range-select tags — useful for trialing common filter bundles.; Adan (FE): Shift-range is a bit tricky but implementable. will need clear UX affordance (tooltip?).; Morgan (PM): copy for empty state CTAs — primary: "Create prompt set"; secondary link: "Clear filters". place primary left.; Sarah (A11y): ensure the primary button has aria-describedby pointing to the explanatory copy so screen readers get context.; Eli (UX): small inline example for the empty state: "Try removing filters like model: gpt-4o or status: failed" — terraforming the message reduces cognitive load.; Jules (Design): mock updated with blue-700 and chip focus ring. uploaded new frame v2.; ui-bot: New Figma frame uploaded by Jules: v2-filters-chip-sticky (https://figma.com/...), added to thread.; Adan (FE): implementation notes: 1) use position: sticky on desktop; 2) on mobile collapse to a popover that manages focus; 3) chips use role=toolbar + aria-label="Filter tags"; 4) debounce filter lambda to 200ms.; Morgan (PM): small copy tweak before dev: change "Clear filters" -> "Reset filters" for consistency with other parts of console.; Eli (UX): agree. "Reset filters" feels clearer.; Sarah (A11y): final checklist for PR: keyboard nav, ARIA roles, focus visible styles, descriptive empty-state text, and skip-link to results for screen reader users.; Adan (FE): plan to open a draft PR by EOD Wed. will ping when ready for review.; Morgan (PM): thanks team. follow-ups: Adan drafts PR, Jules updates token/spec in DS, Eli adds microcopy to content doc, Sarah signs off a11y. tagging owners: @Adan @Jules @Sarah. :white_check_mark:; Eli (UX): one last UX nit — when there are zero results because of date range, show a subtle calendar icon and hint about the date filter being active.; Jules (Design): adding calendar hint to empty state v3.; Adan (FE): noted. will add conditional icon + aria-hidden on the decorative icon.; Morgan (PM): good progress. closing thread for now, reopening if PR needs more context.
